summary: Cloud architect and full-stack software engineer with 12+ years building event-driven systems on AWS. I turn legacy platforms into cloud-native, high-availability architectures: multitenant SaaS, hybrid cloud/on-premise commerce, real-time data pipelines. Founder of Eleva (Startup Chile Ignite 2022 winner, 4th generation). Deep in TypeScript/Node.js, C#/.NET Core, Angular, AWS CDK, and CI/CD automation.

experience.title: Lead Software Architect & Full-Stack Engineer
bullets: Spearheaded the transformation of legacy systems into a cloud-native, event-driven architecture, enabling real-time data processing, high availability, and future AI integration.
Designed and deployed a fully automated AWS eCommerce infrastructure using CDK and Projen, supporting ECS clusters, RDS (PostgreSQL/MySQL), Redis, OpenSearch, and RabbitMQ.

Built a custom asynchronous communication middleware in .NET Core, enabling seamless integration between an on-premise POS and Magento (event-driven, domain-driven design, event-sourced catalog, CQRS).
Architected and delivered a modern CI/CD pipeline for a traditionally manual project, streamlining deployments, enabling scalability, and improving operational visibility.
Deployed SymmetricDS in a clustered AWS environment, ensuring robust and scalable data synchronization across services.
Enabled junior developers to contribute meaningfully to complex systems by creating scalable workflows and establishing high development standards.
Acted as hands-on architect, full-stack engineer, DevOps lead, and mentor across the entire platform lifecycle.

experience.title: Founder & Platform Architect
bullets: Founded and operate a multitenant SaaS platform used by schools for 360-degree performance evaluations and improvement plans; winner of Startup Chile Ignite, 4th generation (2022).
Architected the full platform: C#/.NET modular API on ECS Fargate, Angular SPA on S3 + CloudFront, PostgreSQL on Amazon RDS, all provisioned as code with AWS CDK and Projen.
Built CI/CD with AWS CodePipeline (GitHub via CodeConnections) covering infrastructure and applications across dev/qa/prod environments.

Designed the event-driven, multitenant domain model and the operations tooling, including a control panel that renders the live architecture from deployed CloudFormation and schedules environments down outside school hours to control cost.
Integrating AI assistant capabilities while keeping decision-making functions deterministic and auditable.

experience.title: Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer
bullets: Participated in requirements gathering to solidify prerequisites and determine the best technical solution for business needs.
Reviewed code, debugged problems, and corrected issues on the C# .NET Core backend (GraphQL, gRPC, event-driven design).
Created and updated Azure Cosmos DB database designs and data models.
Developed the front-end of the Clover SMB product using Angular 13.

experience.title: Software Engineer
bullets: Delivered front-end projects in Angular (versions 2 through 11) and React for clients across industries.
Built APIs in Node.js, .NET Core, Java JEE, and Spring Boot.
Designed and maintained AWS cloud architectures for MVP deployments.
Wrote unit tests to sustain high code coverage; troubleshot, tested, and refactored software to improve efficiency.
Provided professional services and support in dynamic work environments.

experience.title: PHP Full-Stack Developer
bullets: Developed and managed databases using PHP, ORM, and SQL.
Reviewed code, debugged problems, and corrected issues in research-supporting web tooling.
